title: Salmon soy rice bowl
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single original food illustration for a recipe card. Subject: Salmon soy rice bowl. Ingredient reference: Salmon fillet, Rice, Soy sauce, Lemon, Water, Vegetable oil. Preparation reference: One batch makes 2 portions. Preparation: 10 minutes; cooking: 25 minutes; additional resting/chilling: 0 minutes. Put the rice and water in a small lidded saucepan. Bring to a boil, cover and cook over low heat for 15 minutes; rest covered off the heat for 5 minutes. Cut the salmon into two pieces and juice the lemon. Heat the vegetable oil in a nonstick frying pan over medium heat and cook the salmon for 4 minutes per side, until the centre reaches 63 C. Lower the heat and add the soy sauce and lemon juice for 30 seconds. Serve the salmon and its pan juices over the rice..
